summary: Layer 1B universe expansion for the employer-funded workforce training node found four US-listed direct-exposure candidates. The reference/context lane is Stride because its Career Learning disclosures explicitly include employer talent-development services. The underfollowed discovery lane includes Strategic Education, Franklin Covey, and Udemy, where exposure is tied to employer-affiliated enrollment platforms, enterprise training subscriptions, and organizational performance training rather than consumer edtech lead generation. Claims are intentionally kept at Layer 1B evidence level; no investment recommendation is made.
